DEFINE art test, round 4: interpolated physique ladder

Press Run once: 12 images (2 rows x 6 stages).

Only the two extremes are written as text. Stages in between blend the two encodings: m00 = fully scrawny, m100 = fully muscular.

Row EN: physique sentence in English. Row ZH: in Chinese.

Check: even steps between stages? Pose/costume/face steady?

Stylized 3D animated feature film character render, soft studio lighting, slightly glossy suit material, appealing stylized proportions, high-end animation studio quality.

Full-body character design of an original superhero, an adult man standing facing the viewer in a confident heroic stance, feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed and held slightly away from his body, the whole figure visible from head to toe with empty space around it. He wears a sleek form-fitting suit in hot magenta and deep navy with electric cyan accent lines along the arms and sides, navy gloves and boots, and a short sunset-orange cape that hangs behind his shoulders. A navy domino mask covers his eyes, with glowing cyan eye lenses; short dark hair. On his chest is a bold geometric emblem: a white diagonal dumbbell inside a cyan diamond. Plain flat pale grey background, no scenery, no text, no logos, no watermark.

His physique: very scrawny and out of shape, skinny noodle arms with no muscle, narrow sloping shoulders, a sunken flat chest and a small soft belly.
